video:video.video:description: Deep dive into the lore and secret history of Midgard Zero. Discover the dark origins of the Bio Labs.

video:video.video:title: Is Priest Good for New Players in WoW Forever?
video:video.video:description: Is Priest a good class for new players in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Yes. Priest is one of the most new-player-friendly classes in WoW Forever: it deals a surprising amount of damage while leveling, has huge self-survivability, almost no downtime, and can heal dungeons without being "just a healer". In this video Ryan Geldun explains why, from Shadow Word: Pain at level 4 and Power Word: Shield at level 6 to wands and dungeon healing.

video:video.video:title: Early Game Priest Guide for WoW Forever (Levels 1-20)
video:video.video:description: How do you level a Priest early in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Go Shadow, get a wand at level 5, stack Spirit, Intellect and Stamina with +healing and +spell damage gear, and use Shadow Word: Pain plus wand as your rotation. In this video Ryan Geldun shows his own Priest from level 1 to 20 in WoW Forever: stats, talents, wands, consumables, Tailoring and dungeon gear, recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: How to AoE Level a Priest in WoW Forever
video:video.video:description: Can a Priest AoE level in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Yes, just not with AoE spells. In this video Ryan Geldun farms 4-5 mobs at a time as a level 26 Shadow Priest in the Wetlands: DoT everything, Psychic Scream the pack, kill one mob fast for Spirit Tap and let the rest die to DoTs and wand. Recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: Discipline Priest Leveling in WoW Forever
video:video.video:description: Is Discipline Priest good for leveling in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Yes. A Discipline Priest levels almost as smoothly as a Shadow Priest and heals dungeons much more easily. In this video Ryan Geldun shares his hands-on experience after respeccing his Priest from Shadow to Discipline around level 30: talents, rotation, DPS, mana and gear, recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: How to Heal Dungeons as a Priest in WoW Forever
video:video.video:description: How do you heal dungeons as a Priest in WoW Forever? Keep the tank alive with Power Word: Shield, cast one Heal only when it's needed, and spend the rest of your time doing damage. Wand, dot enemies with Shadow Word: Pain and land last hits to proc Spirit Tap so you almost never run out of mana. Recorded live in a WoW Forever dungeon at level 30+, November 2026. Most groups in the Looking for Group tool are short on healers, so this is the fastest way to get into dungeons.

video:video.video:title: Disc Priest Keybinds and Healing Without Addons in WoW Forever
video:video.video:description: Do you need addons to heal in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? No. Ryan Geldun heals dungeons on a Discipline Priest with no healing addons at all. In this video he shows his full Disc Priest keybind layout, the targeting keybinds he uses instead of mouseover macros, and three built-in WoW Forever interface settings that replace most healer addons: raid-style party frames, class colors and cooldown numbers. Recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: Shadow Priest or Warlock in WoW Forever?
video:video.video:description: Shadow Priest or Warlock in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? If you want group content, dungeons and short queues, play a Shadow Priest. If you want the biggest damage, stronger crowd control and demons, play a Warlock. In this video Ryan Geldun compares both at level 34 in WoW Forever, after playing Warlock through WoW Classic (2019) and TBC and testing a Warlock in Forever up to level 15. Recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: Level 40 Priest Talents in WoW Forever: Discipline and Shadow Builds
video:video.video:description: Level 40 Priest talents in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever): Ryan Geldun buys Dual Talent Specialization at level 42 and shows both builds, a 26/0/7 Discipline Priest build for solo questing, dungeons and healing, and a 2/0/31 Shadow Priest build with Shadowform, then tests Shadow damage in The Stockade.

video:video.video:title: Can a Priest Solo Elite Quests in WoW Forever?
video:video.video:description: Can a Priest solo elite quests in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Yes. In this video Ryan Geldun solos Mor'Ladim (Morladim), the level 35 elite skeleton at Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood, on a level 35 Priest with no group. The method: kite the elite around fences it cannot jump over, keep Shadow Word: Pain up, wand it down and heal with Renew. Recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: Can a Priest Solo Farm Gold in WoW Forever? (Silk Cloth Spot)
video:video.video:description: Can a Priest solo farm gold in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Yes. In this video Ryan Geldun farms Silk Cloth and Wool Cloth solo on a level 34 Discipline Priest in the Dawning Wood Catacombs, the crypt under Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. The zombies there are level 26-29, respawn fast and drop only stackable loot, so you can farm for a whole level. Recorded in November 2026.

video:video.video:title: Early Gold Farm Spot in WoW Forever
video:video.video:description: Where can you farm early gold in WoW Forever? My two favorite spots for a level 30+ character are in Hillsbrad Foothills and the Alterac Mountains border. Syndicate humanoids drop Silk Cloth, raw silver and green items. Coastal turtles are almost never farmed by anyone and drop vendor items plus skinning materials. Shown on my Priest in WoW Forever, November 2026.

video:video.video:title: How to Make Gold for a Mount as a Disc Priest in WoW Forever
video:video.video:description: Yes, a healer can make mount gold in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever) without charging for heals. I bought Apprentice Riding at level 40 as a Discipline Priest (Human, Alliance) in November 2026, and most of the gold came from running Scarlet Monastery as the healer for the last 2–3 levels before 40.

video:video.video:title: Can a Priest PvP in WoW Forever? (Warsong Gulch)
video:video.video:description: Can a Priest PvP in World of Warcraft: Forever (WoW Forever)? Yes. In this video Ryan Geldun takes a level 26 Shadow Priest into Warsong Gulch (20-29 bracket) during Warsong Weekend, unscripted and not playing Holy, and wins with 4 killing blows, almost 10,000 damage and almost 10,000 healing. Recorded in November 2026.
